Jobs.Description: Calls the ingestion function to process pending catalog vector updates
Jobs.Name: ProcessVectorBatchJob

Jobs.Description: Publishes an event to clean up successfully sent emails
Jobs.Name: CleanUpSentEmailJob

Jobs.Description: Publishes an event to retry previously failed email deliveries
Jobs.Name: ResendErrorEmailJob

Jobs.Description: Emits a periodic scheduler heartbeat for observability
Jobs.Name: HeartbeatJob

Triggers.Description: Fires every five minutes to refresh changed catalog vectors
Triggers.Name: ProcessVectorBatchTrigger

Triggers.Description: Fires every hour to clean up sent emails
Triggers.Name: CleanUpSentEmailTrigger

Triggers.Description: Fires every hour to resend failed emails
Triggers.Name: ResendErrorEmailTrigger

Triggers.Description: Fires every 30 seconds to record scheduler activity
Triggers.Name: HeartbeatTrigger
